sources.title: MUARA CONTAINER TERMINAL, MUARA PORT 2004-2015
sources.owner: Berthing Section and Statistic Unit, Ports Department

notes: Containers handled at Muara Container Terminal, 2004–2015, in TEUs, as published: local (bound for or from Brunei) and transhipment (transiting). 'total_teu' is local + transhipment, as the Ports Department's data definition describes; the published total ('total_published_teu') differs from it in most years ('gap_teu', at most 2.4%). Two values are published with a half TEU. Transhipment share computed by the author.
